release.indexCompatibility: Only current generator-v17 snapshots are retrievable; rebuild earlier publications explicitly.

summary: Verify whether one explicit profile route is ready for an agent to request Brief or Pack context, then return one compact fail-closed readiness envelope.

command.name: ready
command.syntax: shin-context --profile PROFILE --profile-dir PROFILE_DIR --root PROJECT --out-dir INDEX ready [--marker FILE] [--routing-config FILE --task QUERY] [--limit N] [--strict] [--verbose]
command.exitPolicy: Exit 0 only when every required route/adoption identity is aligned, worktree-diff is current, and compact aggregate validation passes. Otherwise emit the complete readiness envelope and exit 1.

steps.passCondition: state=current-route and recommendation profile, canonical profile registry, canonical root, and optional marker match the explicit invocation
marker passes its normal semantic contract, marker.profile.id equals --profile, and marker.index.key equals the --out-dir basename

steps.requiredWhen: route and adoption prerequisites are aligned
steps.passCondition: the verified publication is exact-current against profile-owned worktree inputs

steps.requiredWhen: route and adoption prerequisites are aligned
steps.passCondition: all six profile, index-integrity, and retrieval-quality gates pass; adoption remains a separate readiness step

execution.prerequisitePolicy: Routing is evaluated before adoption. A route mismatch opens no output index. Adoption is evaluated before index access. An adoption mismatch skips worktree and validation.
execution.snapshotBoundary: After prerequisites pass, ready opens the existing shared index lock across worktree-diff and validate so both observe one publication boundary. Missing lock or snapshot returns rebuild-index without creating any files or directories. Readiness never repairs the optional freshness cache.
execution.nestedCommandPolicy: Existing command implementations execute in-process and emit one captured JSON result. No shell, subprocess, alternate validator, retrieval path, or ranker is introduced.
execution.diagnosticPolicy: Default output uses shin.validation-summary.v2 and projects successful and failed steps to compact bounded identity, summary, failed-gate, and reason-code fields. diagnostic_ids identify each failed step. --verbose invokes full shin.validation.v1 and retains complete nested step results.
execution.remediationPolicy: When a deterministic safe follow-up exists, next_command returns a JSON argv array plus explicit mutation flags. It is never a shell string and is never executed automatically.
execution.failFast: Independent validation gates remain non-fail-fast. Route and adoption are explicit safety prerequisites rather than hidden fallbacks.

options.marker: Accepts the same safe absolute or dotted path normalization below --root as adoption-check and validate.
options.routing: --routing-config and --task must be supplied together. Ambiguous, no-match, and cross-route recommendations make the current invocation not ready; ready never follows the recommendation automatically.
options.strict: Forwards strict policy to adoption-check, worktree-diff, and aggregate validation. Readiness always requires current worktree and current eval/Pack evidence.

output.alignment: Reports routing and adoption requirement/alignment booleans independently from nested command execution status.
output.summary: Reports attempted, passed, failed, skipped, readiness requirement failures, worktree current status, and validation status.

ownership.core: Owns option parsing, prerequisite ordering, exact invocation alignment, shared snapshot lock, nested command capture, compact result projection, and next-action classification.
ownership.routingConfig: Owns product and ecosystem routing signals, project roots, profiles, registries, and marker paths.
ownership.adoptionMarker: Owns permanent profile id, external index key, context epoch, and required project quality gates.
ownership.agent: Owns the task query, whether a known route needs routing verification, rebuilding stale output, and the later Brief or Pack request.

nonGoals: No build, repair, vacuum apply, profile switch, federation, or context retrieval.
No automatic marker or routing-config discovery.
No daemon, watcher, MCP server, IDE process control, or background mutation.
No replacement for release, sanitizer, performance, or ecosystem gates.

requiredEvidence: strict adopted readiness with canonical absolute marker normalization
cross-route and no-match results skip index access
rebuild-index returns a non-executed build argv with index mutation true and consumer mutation false
default failures omit nested validation gates while --verbose retains them
invalid routing option pairs and unknown options fail with typed usage errors
relocated portable install includes and executes ready

retrievalAvailability.requirements: The aggregate availability verdict, route alignment, adoption alignment and a current worktree must all pass. Existing ok/ready fields and exit codes retain their strict meaning.
